title: Jesus' Ministry in Galilee
description: After John is imprisoned, Jesus moves from Nazareth to Capernaum in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali, fulfilling the prophecy of Isaiah about a great light for people living in darkness. He begins to preach repentance because the kingdom of heaven is near, calls his first disciples by the Sea of Galilee, and travels throughout Galilee teaching in synagogues, proclaiming the good news of the kingdom, and healing every kind of disease and sickness, so that his fame spreads everywhere.
